campaign: Reduce the surface of execution, evidence and development while capability and pace grow

paragraphs.text: overgo improves models, and itself, through its own inference and training, unattended. Every row closes or speeds up the improvement loop (measure, find the gap, train or change, judge on held-out data), or directly serves inference or training; otherwise it is not filed. The scorecard's gaps generate the work. Progress is each scorecard cell against its previous measurement, not a count of landings: there is no passed state and no promotion. Rows that let a full measurement run finish rank above rows that only harden or slim it, and a run that cannot finish (killed, or with cells that did not pass) outranks every other row.

Finish partly landed rows before opening new ones. A consolidation reuses an existing owner and deletes the implementations it replaces in the same landing. A new shared component is allowed only when no existing owner can serve several real consumers, and it must remove more than it adds.

One meaningful run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match: it is written once, as one record with many readers. A run never judges what it produced, and a run leaves its evidence complete by its own contract (every protocol a suite's acceptance asks for), never half-written for a later landing to trip on.

The landing gate judges the commit; the improvement cycle judges the models. The gate's verdict depends only on the tree: unit, golden, hermetic-fixture and small-device checks. Suites that load real models, read the live store's evidence or sweep the device belong to the cycle, declared by build tag, and the cycle runs them on the commit it measures; a store write never changes a landing's verdict. A change's landing cost is read from its diff as three independent effects: the lanes it reaches, whether it expires the inference-surface guards, and whether it needs a pinned-media reconciliation. Lanes are the main cost, so false lane reach is cut. A surface move also expires every evaluation bound to the surface, so the re-evaluation it forces counts in its cost: surface changes are batched and land before an evaluation run, never between its runs, and the guards are re-acquired once after the last of them. A batch is one coherent change, normally one to three related rows, closed before it delays a user-facing result that is ready: an operating limit, not a gate. Dependency work is verified twice, separately: its build and test closure, and the guard surface, which stops at overgodb and runrecord. A saving is the net recurring cost removed, after the replacement tests and their maintenance. A check retires only when its replacement covers the check's actual acceptance contract, whether it moves to the cycle or is deleted; the landing scorecard reports and never refuses, so it replaces no check. The gate writes all numbers; messages name causes, effects and what disappears.

A step's verify fails before the change and passes after; a verify that already passes proves nothing, so a boundary is proved by the table row that fails today. Before a landing, what the gate refuses cheaply is run locally first: the claims check after any hand edit, the invariant tables, the rules' budget and exports, and the step's verify. A refusal found after the lanes costs an hour, and a retried landing rebuilds an identical gate binary.

Each row's rationale carries four plain lines: Serves (the loop stage, or the model or capability it runs or trains), Disappears (the owner reused, the implementations deleted, the tests retired or kept), Evidence (the run and record it reads or produces, and who else reads that record), Batch (the lanes its diff reaches, whether it expires the guards, and whether it needs a media reconciliation: three independent effects, each checked against the diff).

Landing speed is protected by observing it, not by a rule. Each structural boundary (a changed path's lanes, a package kept off the inference surface, a suite kept to the cycle) is pinned as an invariant row in one table per kind, never as a new test function or a snapshot of today's lists. At each periodic review the gate's measured lines in git log are read: the share of landings that reached no lane, lane minutes per landing, and executed versus cached package counts. A rise means a misplaced check or a new false reach, fixed by moving it and adding a table row. There are no time budgets or timeouts, no ratchet baselines, and no separate tracking subsystem.

Training research is measured at the lowest cost that answers the question, reusing what exists. Optimizer math stays on the device: host Muon on the tied embedding cost about 98 s a step, and moving it took a 540-step run from about 21 hours to 6 minutes. During training only scalars cross to the host (losses, norms, brake decisions), never weights or gradients per step. Reuse comes before acquiring: cached base losses keyed by the exact window plan, existing checkpoints, held-out sets and the verdict code, before any new dataset, pass or tool. An evaluation beats a training run, a norm beats a decomposition, and a one-time computation beats a per-step one. For a training rate question the order is: post-hoc tests on existing checkpoints, then the held-out brake from the training forward against cached base losses, then a per-layer relative step size, and per-direction spectral scaling last.

User-journey performance (owner, 2026-10-05). Optimize complete journeys, measured as action to usable result: submit to first visible answer, cold model selection to usable response, cancel to actual resource release, interrupted cycle to useful progress, with loading, admission wait, execution, publication and rendering kept apart. Start from the existing native benchmarks, allocation counts and CPU profiles of repeated reads, model loads, allocations and evidence reconstruction, and keep added instrumentation only when it explains a real elapsed-time gain. In the development loop one valid gate execution is shared by every compatible plan step and obligation, and validation and reuse are scoped by the actual dependencies (kernels, generated and embedded data, models, recipes, environment, subprocess effects); an unknown dependency keeps the broader coverage. A gain is judged against total maintenance cost (production code, tests, fixtures, instrumentation, gate work and upkeep): remove repeated processing through existing owners, and decline small gains that need disproportionate machinery. Prove with behavioral regression tests and comparable benchmarks, never a new performance ratchet, selector or framework.

Pace (owner, 2026-10-09). Steps that change one mechanism land together. A measurement already taken retires the step that would take it. Work that only waits is filed early, so its wait runs while the rows between are built. A full measurement run (go run ./cmd/loop -improve) continues only at the commit it began at and is started outside a session, so no time limit ends it. Rows that move no measured result land while it runs; rows that change a served result or a timing follow it, stand side by side, and land before the next run, never between its runs.

The repository keeps Go, CUDA and HTML/JS, and extends an existing owner before it adds one. Each row begins with a measurement and fixes its acceptance before its code is written; a measurement already taken is reused when it is enough. A row deletes the implementation it replaces in the same landing; a reader that records already in the store need stays until those records are migrated. A pilot that is not accepted is taken out of the served path, and its measurements and the reason it was refused are kept.

The production growth refusal stays. A row with no count adds no net production code, which is the default: a migration deletes at least what it adds. A row that adds a mechanism before it deletes one carries a count, set in a change to the plan alone before its code, from the figure the gate's preflight gives its built change, and read from the commit the change builds on; a count set before the row is built is an estimate and says so. An item's count is for all its landings together: each landing's growth is charged to it and what is left is what the next may add. Test code, fixtures, record schemas and CUDA source are reported with each landing and not refused; a test is retired only when its replacement catches the same seeded failure.

The gate judges the candidate tree by hermetic and small-device checks; real-model quality and speed are measured by the cycle. A stored result is reused only under an unchanged identity of the code, model, recipe, data, settings and request it depends on. A request for a fresh measurement always runs, and a dependency that cannot be named keeps the wider scope. Resident resources, compiled execution and a request have separate identities, built by one mechanism into separate keys for sessions, outputs and scores. Eligibility is kept apart from selection, observations from scores, and the records that choose a candidate from the records that confirm it.

An experiment is frozen before it trains: a protocol missing a numerical gain or resource criterion is not dispatched, and a pilot does not change the acceptance of the objective it is compared with. Completing an experiment and adopting its model are separate: a complete negative or inconclusive record closes the experiment and activates nothing.

items.title: Close the gaps the record of resume paths found, a path at a time, where a merge of the paths is not supported

budget.reason: measured by the preflight of step code-in-keys' change at b3ae5ef4a: the code's name in four command keys, and the binding of the offline merge's stage to its plan and its sources' bytes

steps.title: Name the code in the four command keys of the workflow replay that name none, and bind the offline merge's stage
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/resume-paths.txt. The workflow replay reuses a finished stage when its receipt is completed with artifacts, under an operation the caller derives. The served key names the recipe, the request, the code and the bytes beside the model. Four command keys name no code, by the record's reading and not by a run, so a command repeated after a change to the code that computes its stage is answered with what the earlier code left. The offline merge's stage is bound to nothing that names its inputs. The step first writes a failing test for each of the five, which settles what was read: the same request under changed code must run again, and does not. It then names the code in each key the way the served key does, and binds the merge's stage. A key that turns out to name its code already is reported and its test kept.
Serves: failure-rate as a person meets it: a repeated command is never answered by code that is gone.
Disappears: nothing; four keys gain a part.
Evidence: the five tests, each failing before its key is changed and passing after.
Batch: host; internal/capabilityruntime is inside the inference surface, so the change goes just before a full measurement run.

steps.title: Show by a test whether any production path finds an operation's lifecycle record again, and delete the path if none does
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/resume-paths.txt. The operation's own reuse returns a stored record when its run and outputs are held. By the record's reading the manager's salted id is never repeated, so no production path finds a lifecycle record again and the path is one only a test reaches: 5 counted declarations of 664 syntax nodes in a file of 934, with three readers. The step writes the test that shows it either way. If a production path does find a record again, the test holds that path and the step ends there. If none does, the reuse is deleted with what only it used and its three readers are changed, and the record family is left in the store: taking a family out of the store is a rebuild with the family in the table of retired families, which is the lead's store maintenance.
Serves: the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: up to 934 lines' worth of a file, by the record's estimate, if no path finds a record again.
Evidence: the test, and the declarations census with the path's lines gone from its list if they were on it.
Batch: host.

steps.title: Read the four ways the bytes of an input are named, and count what one owner would delete and add
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/resume-paths.txt. Four places name the bytes of an input in four ways: the files beside a model by content, the files a measurement cell is given by path, size and time, an adapter by a digest of its modules, and a merge's base by its shards' digests. Four commits of one family each added the bytes of an input to a key that lacked them (26d332f81, 78534ee41, 2ae868219, 8988728ae), so this is what the repairs have in common. Whether one owner would be smaller than the four was not measured. This step is a reading: what each of the four does, what one owner would have to offer each, lines deleted and added, and the net with its range. It changes no code and decides whether a row is filed.
Serves: the loop's upkeep: the next key that needs an input's bytes takes them from one place.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the reading, added to docs/verification/resume-paths.txt and held by its test.
Batch: host.

items.title: Hold every committed surface to a consumer by a check at every commit, and delete what has none

steps.title: Delete the groups the record classes as dead outside the inference surface
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/unreached-declarations.txt. The groups it classes as dead outside the inference surface hold about 1,170 lines: the recovery of internal/agentloop (373 lines; Coordinator.RestoreSession does the job), the in-memory model merge (255; MergeGGUF and ExecuteStreaming), the memory schedule (202; LayerStreamedBudget), the orphans outside the surface (124), the device operators made one a call (96), the diffusion image pair batch (80), the recognition of a Krea pipeline (43), and the groups that are a schema alone. Each is deleted with the tests that exist only for it, and its lines leave the lists and its group the record. The sort was a reading, so each group is first proved dead: after its deletion every package builds with and without the model tags, and no test of live behaviour is changed. A group that fails that proof stays, and its class and reason in the record are corrected. The model merge and the orphans go before the deletions inside the surface, since they hold the callers of two functions there.
Serves: the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: about 1,170 lines of production code and their tests.
Evidence: the two census tests with those lines gone; every package builds; the packages' tests.
Batch: host.

steps.title: Delete what stands alone of the two unreached groups inside the inference surface, in one commit before a run
steps.rationale:
Split from step delete-unreached, which deleted what stood alone outside the inference surface. Two groups the census lists lie inside the surface: the swap of internal/atomicfile (12 declarations, 451 lines) and the store and writer checks of internal/gitauthority (8, 205). A deletion there moves the keys stored answers are kept under. By the record docs/verification/surface-moves.txt 19 of 29 full measurement runs asked the kept text cases again anyway, so the two groups go in one commit taken just before a run. The builder first applies the operator's rule to each declaration, as step delete-unreached did: what a test of live behaviour uses, or what another unreached path uses, stays on the list for step sort-unreached, and only what stands alone is deleted with the tests that exist for it.
Serves: the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: up to 656 lines of production code inside the inference surface, and their tests.
Evidence: the census test with those lines gone from its list; the two packages' tests; a build of every package with and without the model tags.
Batch: host; one commit, just before a full measurement run.

Widened by the lead on 2026-10-13 from docs/verification/unreached-declarations.txt. The commit takes every group the record classes as dead inside the inference surface, about 1,110 lines: the swap of internal/atomicfile (451), the old gate's checks of internal/gitauthority (200), the encoder-decoder step and batch (163), the orphans inside the surface (146) and the smaller groups. It also takes the test-held groups inside the surface, 707 lines, by the remedy the record names for each. It follows step dead-outside, which removes the callers of two functions here. The groups the lead keeps as prototypes are not touched.

steps.title: Move what only tests use beside those tests, or have the tests take the live path
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/unreached-declarations.txt. 152 declarations of 2,910 lines are used by tests alone, and those tests hold live behaviour. The record names for each of the 23 groups which of two remedies fits. Where the code is a reference, an oracle or a review that exists for the tests, it moves into test files beside them: the Krea host references (609 lines), the source review of internal/webuilane (373, with its test of internal/server moved to the package that owns it), the analyzers outside the surface (175), and the smaller oracles and primitives. Where a test calls an old entry point beside a live one, the test takes the live path and the old entry is deleted: the shared device oracles, the dense model's old entries, the wrappers, the old text entry points and the held-out pool's confirmation among them. Two groups have no clean remedy and are named so: the store's test observers, whose causality query and commit delta read unexported state. They stay on the list with that reason. The groups inside the inference surface, 707 lines, go in the commit that deletes the dead code there.
Serves: the loop's upkeep: production code holds what a command reaches.
Disappears: about 2,200 lines of production code outside the surface, kept as test code or deleted.
Evidence: the census test with those lines gone; the tests that used them unchanged in what they hold.
Batch: host.

steps.title: Read each capability no command offers, and file its route or reclass it
steps.rationale:
From docs/verification/unreached-declarations.txt. Eight groups, 46 declarations of 1,036 lines, are capabilities no command offers, and the record names a route for each: slot save and restore on the server for the session state codecs (433 lines, inside the inference surface), a delegated mode of cmd/agent-loop that binds the task contract and the checkpoint runtime (139), the dense device trainer refusing by derived capacity (108), an MP4 clip beside the served GIF (103), a matrix listing on cmd/training-objective (87), media request admission printing demand against capacity (73), a transport over InvokeRemotePeer (71) and the coordinator opening the tool stream (22). This step reads each: whether the route is one a person would use, what it costs to add, and whether the operator's four conditions for deletion hold instead. It files a step for each route worth adding and reclasses the rest in the record with the reason. It changes no code.
Serves: a route for each capability that has none, or less code where none is worth adding.
Disappears: nothing yet.
Evidence: the record's wire groups each with a filed step or a new class and reason, held by the census test.
Batch: host.

items.title: Keep the reading of repeated structure, consolidate what is truly repeated, and read where the code decides by kind

steps.title: Keep the three readings as one test helper beside the declarations walk: repeated runs by class, call-and-test chains, and switches by kind
steps.rationale:
The proposal's figures came from scratch programs that are gone. The walk that holds every declaration to a command already lives in internal/repoanalysis's tests (90b1ca10c); this reading joins it, in test code, and adds no production code. It reads a tree and lists: runs of five statements whose shape repeats in two or more functions, each classed as flag definitions, call-and-test pairs or other; chains of three or more call-and-test pairs on one receiver; and switches over three or more named constants, grouped into families by the constants they share. The test plants one of each in a fixture and holds the listing to it; run with -v on the repository it prints the listing and asserts nothing, so no figure is pinned.
Serves: the loop's upkeep: the next consolidation is chosen from a reading and not from a guess.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the fixture's families found, and each class told from the others; the repository's listing reproduces the first reading's figures within what has changed since a534ff310.
Batch: host; internal/repoanalysis reaches no longer test run.

steps.title: Read each group of truly repeated logic, and give a common component to those that shrink
steps.rationale:
The first reading's real repeats are 231 groups covering 2,571 lines, and 63 call-and-test chains worth about 590. The largest it printed: the device upload helper written twice in cmd/validate (runDeviceMerger and runDeviceVision, 78 lines in 2 places); the checkpoint-to-model tensor name tables in internal/hfgguf (80 lines in 8 places); the sampling flags declared in both cmd/generate and cmd/latentvideo-run (75 lines in 15 places); field-by-field clone functions in seven packages (70 lines in 14 places); dimension reads in internal/tensor/reference (60 lines in 12 places); the identity, dataset and split triple in ten suite compilers of internal/evaluation; and the chains on the device scope in internal/devicemath (282 lines). Each group is read before it is touched, and the count is written down: lines deleted, lines the component adds, net. A group that does not shrink is left and named. The one conversion measured so far, a training route onto an objective, added 87 lines (c84a7d7b7), so no saving is assumed. From the lead's review: the reading is taken after the declarations the census classes as dead are deleted, because a repeat inside code no command reaches is deleted and not consolidated, and internal/devicemath alone holds 54 unreached declarations of 2,099 lines.
Serves: the loop's upkeep; nothing a person runs changes.
Disappears: the repeats of each group consolidated. The whole step is expected to remove under 1% of production code; that is an estimate.
Evidence: the reading before and after; each consolidated group absent from the listing; every changed package's tests unchanged.
Batch: host for most groups. internal/evaluation is in the identity stored answers are kept under, and internal/tensor/reference is in the inference surface, so groups there are gathered into one change before a full measurement run, or left.

steps.title: Read what each switch over the tensor operations decides, and count what one table of operations would delete and add
steps.rationale:
The owner's expectation is that consolidation exposes the structural refactors. The first reading exposes one: of 146 switches over named constants (5,706 lines, 85 families), the tensor operations are decided in 10 switches of 2,043 lines, in 10 functions across 4 packages, over 65 constants. Adding or changing an operation means ten places. The next families are far smaller: the media codec kinds (9 switches, 658 lines, 3 packages), the GGUF value types (8, 309) and the tensor element types (6 switches, 231 lines, 5 packages). This step is a reading, as the one that judged suites-as-data was: for every operation and every one of the ten switches, what is decided there (its shape, its host arithmetic, its device launch, its cache or layout rule), which of those could be one row of a table, and what the table's machinery would cost. It reports the net with its range, and names what the table would make possible that is not possible now. It decides whether a row is filed; it changes no code. From the lead's review: the reading also says how a table of operations stands to the dense block program that was taken out (docs/verification/dense-block-program.txt), which failed two of its five conditions and named two operations it lacked, so that a row filed from this reading does not repeat that pilot under another name.
Serves: train and serve: one place to add an operation; the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: docs/verification/operation-kinds.txt, derived by the test from the analyzer's listing of the ten switches at the commit it names.
Batch: host; nothing inside the inference surface changes.

items.title: Retire the sealed authority, a requirement over artifacts that no longer exist

steps.title: Remove the sealed-authority command, its record and the protection requirement
steps.rationale:
From the proposal, narrowed to what is the owner's. .github/protection.json requires a sealed authority over promotion-policy and champion-alias (lines 18 to 25 at cc82ed097), artifacts of a promotion removed on 2026-10-05, and the store has never held a record of the family (by the proposal). The protection file states a security requirement, so the decision retire-sealed-authority blocks this row and asks about that alone; if the answer keeps it, the lead retires this row with plan -retire. Not in this row: mechanism-census, a lead of consumer-checks/record-schemas under the lead's rule; and offline-artifact-validate, whose records serve model prototypes and stay.
Serves: the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: the command, its record family and the requirement.
Evidence: no command, schema or requirement of the set remains; the commands kept still pass.
Batch: host; the API manifest and the SBOM are regenerated.

items.title: Make the exploratory request protocol a protocol of the evaluation command, and reproduce its one result

steps.title: Make the exploratory request protocol a named, fully identified protocol of the evaluation command
steps.rationale:
From the proposal, kept. The largest quality effect on record, 34 correct answers against 20 on the same 40 questions for Qwen3.5-4B, came from a scratch program the evaluation tools cannot run (finding 69b4c1ed, by the proposal). It changed the thinking switch, the wording, the sampling settings, the token limit and the answer parser together, so the gain belongs to the whole protocol until ablations separate them. Identify all of those with the model, the cases and the scorer; mark the 40 cases as exposed development evidence.
Serves: held-out-quality.
Disappears: a result only a scratch program can produce.
Evidence: host fixtures show the command expresses and records the whole protocol.
Batch: host.

steps.title: Reproduce the result once with the named protocol, and state the difference a search must detect
steps.rationale:
The lead's, in place of the proposal's freeze, search and pilot, which are a hypothesis until this reports: an enumeration with restart and fault tests is a mechanism with no second case while one result exists and has not been repeated. Run the 40 questions on Qwen3.5-4B under the protocol of the step before and under the default, a few device-minutes, and record both with the paired test over the cases answered differently. The record states the difference a bounded search would have to detect and what device time that takes, which is the figure the owner's question about an unattended allowance needs; that question, and rows for the search, are filed from this record or not at all. The candidate owners (cmd/loop/evidence.go, internal/plan/candidate_scheduler.go) are not touched: they serve model prototypes.
Serves: held-out-quality.
Disappears: nothing; a result that does not reproduce closes the question.
Evidence: docs/verification/protocol-reproduction.txt, derived by the test from the store's records.
Batch: host for the test; the two evaluations on the quiet machine outside a commit.

Correction by the lead on 2026-10-13, from the check of this step's preparation.

- the step's text says "a few device-minutes"
- the only measured figure = commit 642b3943c's message: "40 questions took three hours" for both ways of asking
- so the two evaluations of this step take about three device hours, unless the sample is cut

steps.title: Fold the MMLU-Pro kind into the grouped-choice kind, its identities unchanged
steps.rationale:
The one saving the reading of the retired row suites-as-data found that needs no new machinery. evaluateMMLUPro (internal/evaluation/mmlu_pro.go:157-191) is EvaluateGroupedChoice (grouped_choice.go:102-136) but for a delimiter on the scorer's method and the name of one report field, and its few-shot code (:114-124) is unused by its one producer. Folding MMLU-Pro into the grouped-choice kind with one delimiter field removes about 165 lines for about 20, by reading. It is safe only if the dataset identity, the case profile and the scorer's method marshal to the bytes they do now (multiple_choice.go:41-57, :166, :226-228; mmlu_pro.go:140-149), which the proving test holds case by case, and the stored report overgo/mmlu-pro-report/v1 keeps its readers (inspect.go:47, cmd/validate/media_coverage.go:635). The change asks every MMLU-Pro case again, as any change to the package does, so it goes in the batch that changes internal/evaluation anyway.
Serves: the loop's upkeep.
Disappears: about 145 lines of internal/evaluation, an estimate by reading.
Evidence: the comparison identity of the MMLU-Pro plan unchanged, byte for byte, on the store's cases.
Batch: host; with the other changes to internal/evaluation, before a full measurement run.

items.title: Make a timing and a quality reading trustworthy before anything is judged by them

budget.reason: measured by the preflight of step reference-and-noise's change at 3e3980f5f: the reference built from a cell's own readings, the printed-digits floor, and the earlier-measurement reader the printed moves keep, less the frozen allowances and the float32 comparison

steps.title: Judge a held-out quality move by the exact paired test over the cases answered differently
steps.rationale:
Split from step reference-and-noise, whose text asks for it. After that step a held-out quality declines by any move the scorecard's four printed digits show, so one case of a suite answered wrong where it was answered right files a row. Over the 32 published records a quality cell was read again by a new source 823 times and 808 of those gave the same value, most of them a result carried forward and not scored again; two were declines, of 0.0024 on an accuracy and of 0.0011 on a word error rate. A move is a decline when, over the cases the two readings answered differently, more went from right to wrong than the exact paired test allows (tensorstats.ExactPairedBinary, as internal/evaluation/instruction_acceptance.go uses it). A cell carries no per-case outcomes: a choice report in the store does, reached from a cell's source through its run (internal/evaluation/evidence_index.go, the path unreadAnswers walks). Decide first where the two readings' outcomes are read: from the store when a record is compared, which Gaps and Compare do not take today, or kept beside the cell when it is published. A metric with a stated standard error and no per-case outcomes is judged by that error, and one with neither reads Unknown once it moves beyond the printed digits. If the owner's amendment row for one table of measurements is ever taken, this reads that table.
Serves: held-out-quality: a row for a model that answers worse, and none for one that answers a few cases differently.
Disappears: the judging of a quality by its value alone.
Evidence: two stored readings of one suite, paired case by case, in a temporary store; the published history's two quality declines judged both ways.
Batch: host; a change to internal/evaluation is in the answer scope and goes just before a full measurement run.

Ranked behind policy-search by the lead on 2026-10-13. The reader of a report's per-case outcomes belongs beside unreadAnswers in internal/evaluation, and any file change there asks every case of every suite again (internal/inferencesurface/identity.go:57,276-296). It is taken in the same batch as policy-search/protocol, which changes that package anyway, or after evidence-identity narrows what an answer depends on. Design leaning: Gaps stays a reading of published records; where the loop files a decline of a quality (cmd/loop Propose) it opens the store, reads the two readings' reports, and drops a decline the exact paired test does not support at the tail two standard errors leave, the package's noiseDeviates. A quality with no per-case outcomes is judged by its value as now, so no metric stops filing.

decisions.question: When validate-currency is otherwise ready, should the Qwen3.5-9B hybrid training proof (22m05 a cycle, the same cmd/train route and code as the blocking 4B proof) move to the background, so promotion stops waiting on every training proof? decisions.question: The scorecard's serving cells (first-output, throughput, load-time, peak-device-memory) aggregate every attempt a recipe ever made: medians over all time, total tokens over total decode time, the highest peak ever. A landed improvement shows only as old samples are outnumbered and a peak never falls. Since delete-selection each cycle measures every serving cell once at the measured commit. Should those cells read the newest successful measured attempt instead, accepting one sample's timing noise in each cycle's moved list?
options: newest measured attempt
all-time aggregates
median of the newest few attempts
decisions.recommendation: newest measured attempt
decisions.answer: newest measured attempt

decisions.question: Held-out quality is unscored for forecast, image-embedding, image-gen, seq2seq, tabular and vqa because each needs a held-out set the store lacks. Answering authorizes exactly these downloads into the datasets root, each to be verified by hash once fetched: ETTh1 (github.com/zhouhaoyi/ETDataset, 2.6 MB, forecast); BFCL v3 simple (gorilla-llm/Berkeley-Function-Calling-Leaderboard, 0.3 MB, seq2seq); BeyondArena credit-g (TabArena/BeyondArena, 0.2 MB, tabular); TIFA v1.0 (github.com/Yushi-Hu/tifa, 10 MB, image-gen); A-OKVQA validation (HuggingFaceM4/A-OKVQA, 60 MB, vqa); Imagenette 160 px (fast.ai imagenette2-160, 100 MB, image-embedding). About 173 MB in all. The other five unscored rows (generation, projection, speech, training, video-gen) use sets already on disk and are not blocked.
options: Download all six (about 173 MB)
Download only the four under 11 MB (ETTh1, BFCL, credit-g, TIFA)
Download none and score only what is on disk
decisions.recommendation: Download all six (about 173 MB)
decisions.answer: Download only the four under 11 MB (ETTh1, BFCL, credit-g, TIFA)

decisions.question: Editing a pinned media runtime path (go.mod, kernels, internal/cuda, tensor, devicemath and the rest of docs/image_video_merged.json's runtime paths) needs a reviewed delta: a device receipt, a delta entry, and the registry's identity pinned in a test, built by hand twice on 2026-10-04 and again for every kernel row ahead (e4b-decode-graph, decode-small-kernels). It exists so media evidence acquired at the pinned runtime stays valid across an output-neutral edit. Since the cycle re-acquires every media cell at the commit it promotes, and its models lane runs the media acceptance tests against the frozen references, the evidence that gate protects is re-proved every cycle: it is the same per-cell currency check validate-currency deleted. Retire the registry, its pin and the gate-time check (about 600 lines of test code, the registry JSON and the landing's pinned-path rule), or keep it and build a one-command tool for it (row media-delta-command)?
options: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract
Keep the pin and build the one-command delta tool (media-delta-command)
decisions.recommendation: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract
decisions.answer: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract

decisions.question: Speech, image-gen and video-gen quality cannot be scored by the model alone: pocket-tts outputs audio, the image generators pictures, Wan2.1 and Un-0 clips. Each proposal scores the output by a second local model: a speech recognizer for round-trip word error rate, a vision-language model for TIFA questions and for matching a clip to its caption. evaluate has no suite in which a generator's output is judged by another model, and a record must name both the generator's recipe, which the scorecard reads, and the judge's identity, which the score depends on. One judged-generation suite kind (the projection session already shows a video to Qwen3.8-27B) would serve all three rows and their eight models, with a new session for each judge modality.
options: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen
Score speech by its recognizer round trip only, and leave image-gen and video-gen unscored
Leave all three unscored
decisions.recommendation: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen
decisions.answer: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen

decisions.question: Held-out quality of training is scored for a recipe only by a train -objective session, which publishes a held-out verdict. Qwen2.5-0.5B trains through that route and now has its verdict (a token-prediction objective over a held-out third of the WikiText-2 articles). The other six training recipes belong to routes that prove the route rather than score text: Qwen3.5-4B and 9B hybrid-stack (a bounded observed full-stack run whose evidence is that loss descends), Wan2.1 and LiveEdit dit, Hy-Embodied mot. None of those routes holds out data or scores a model, and a token-prediction objective does not fit a diffusion or a mixture-of-transformers model. Scoring them means giving each route a held-out objective of its own (days of work each, and a 20-step proof run's held-out value says little). Which do you want?
options: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route
Give each proof route a held-out objective and score its recipe
Leave the proof-route recipes unscored
decisions.recommendation: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route
decisions.answer: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route

decisions.question: The GUI lane's worktree was removed on 2026-10-09 and the lane left what it recommends and did not land in the main checkout, as docs/gui_update_plan.json: a deadline on every browser wait, a top-p control in Settings, the output size shown before an export, the Train tab's samples shown while a run goes, rsLoRA and LoRA+ offered for an adapter run, a few demo datasets, documents turned into a conversation dataset, the resident model kept only when it fits beside a training run, and whether a chat turn needs the request number a workflow run carries, with its notes for starting a lane again. The file is not committed: nothing reads it, the repository keeps no document without a reader, and it is ignored in that checkout so it stays as the lane left it. decisions.question: identity-carry was filed to carry an evaluation only while the code it depends on is unchanged and to delete the sampled replay. Measured 2026-10-09: 46 of the 87 newest results stand on a replay-carried result, 30 of them carried 19 or 20 times; scoring those 46 in full took 13 hours 55 minutes; the code an evaluation depends on changed on 112 of the last 300 commits and cycles lie hundreds of commits apart, so with the replay deleted every cycle scores them all again, about 14 hours more a cycle. The replay's sample is the same 32 cases every time, so a change that misses them is never seen. What should carrying do?
options: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle
Leave carrying as it is
decisions.recommendation: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
decisions.answer: Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle

decisions.question: evaluation-chain's last step, acceptance, adds a memory ceiling and a speed target to a held-out pool's acceptance and has a confirmation refuse a candidate with no resource comparison against the base within them. Every candidate the proposer makes today is other weights of the base's shape, so it has the base's memory and speed, and no row in the plan makes another kind of candidate; a served recipe's memory and speed are already read by the scorecard and by the routing decision. When should the step be built?
options: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
Now, ahead of such a candidate
Not at all: leave memory and speed to the scorecard and the routing decision
decisions.recommendation: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
decisions.answer: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed

decisions.question: The video codec can now convolve a clip of about ten frames or more through NVIDIA's cuDNN. Measured beside another job on the device: a decode about a third faster, an encode about a fifth, the decoder holding 6.0 GiB where it held 9.6, and every value within one of 255 levels of what overgo's own kernels give. It does so only on a machine where cuDNN is on the search path or in the bin directory CUDA_PATH names. This machine's only copy is inside a Python environment, so it still serves by the kernels and the automated checks skip the library's tests. Installing it is yours to do: cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12, about 800 MB, from NVIDIA under NVIDIA's license. The frozen video clips are the kernels' bytes, and I would accept them again under the library afterwards. Install it here?
options: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it
Keep this machine on the kernels; the library stays for machines that have it
Take the library's path back out
decisions.recommendation: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it
decisions.answer: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it
